author: bsisler
quote: Very disappointed. I was expecting them to keep with the GTA5 style where you could kill anyone if you wanted to but it appears the woke movement crap has been snuck into the game and certain alphabet people are protected from your rampage. Also the story is underwhelming and seems to be a relationship simulator more than a grand they auto game. The emergency Vehicles and lighting looks like they were pulled form watvh dogs, the lighting on them is very minimal and the textures seem ugly.
